long_biography.plain_text:
Before establishing RVG, Gothier was already active in central Pennsylvania property deals. In 1980, working through Keystone Commercial Realty, he negotiated a transaction involving a mobile-home park. That episode places his early career in brokerage and acquisition, the foundations for a broader development business.

RVG grew into an integrated Mid-Atlantic platform for acquiring, building and managing property. Its portfolio ranged from grocery-anchored shopping centres to office buildings and residential communities. Beyond development, Gothier helped form Centric Bank as a founding director, later serving as director emeritus. His banking service added a regional governance role to decades spent shaping commercial projects around Harrisburg.
